title: OpenAI reportedly raises an additional $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
slides: OpenAI just raised $11 billion — but why now?
Investors priced the company at $1.25 trillion.
That money may not cover next year's compute bills.
Your AI tools could get pricier as costs shift down.
Ask your vendor what this funding changes for pricing.
thread_text:
1. The $11B question

OpenAI just closed an $11 billion round. Investors handed it over at a $1.25 trillion valuation — and the timing is the story.

2. Compute bills are coming

The raise may not cover next year's compute costs. Training and inference bills are growing faster than revenue.

3. The bill lands on you

As costs shift downstream, your AI tools could get pricier. Vendors will pass the squeeze to users.

4. Pricing is the real signal

Watch for tier changes, usage caps, and per-seat hikes. The funding news is a preview of your next invoice.

5. Ask this one question

Ask your AI vendor what this funding changes for pricing. Get the answer in writing before renewal.
